values.note: Daily starting rates, summer (May 1 - October 31): electric only $42, water and electric $47, 30-amp full hookup $55, 50-amp full hookup $60, rustic $35. Winter (November 1 - April 30): electric only $50, electric and sewer (weather permitting) $53, rustic $35. Rates cover 2 adults and 4 children; $5 a night per extra person. Phone reservations carry a $5 service fee (once per booking). Weekly and monthly rates too.

values.note: Open every day all year; site water is winterized on or after October 15, after which water is in the heated restrooms and sewer is usable on warm days only.

note: Formerly Camp Withii; under new ownership since 2020, on Hampton Rd in Harrison, within walking distance of Wilson State Park on Budd Lake. Seasonal campers alongside short-stay guests; winter guests clear their own site of snow. Not on water. --Claude
summary: Operator site live: confirmed the daily rates $42 electric-only to $60 50-amp full hookup (stored; now manual with winter rates and the $5 phone-booking fee in the note), 50-amp/water/sewer, year-round (site water winterized from mid-October), showers/heated restrooms/dump/wifi/potable water; booking by phone. Not stated by the operator: site count (88) or max rig (50 ft) (left as derived). Daily, weekly, monthly and seasonal sites; the operator says many guests stay the whole summer but gives no seasonal count, and posts nightly rates, so long-stay test 2 passes. Gate: $42 base, under US$50. Note cleaned of hookup, site and year-round text.
